name: bada-cinevim
description: Bada CineVim — a cinematic VIM editor for the Bada quantum programming language. Real modal editing (motions, operators, registers, undo, dot-repeat, :%s///), Bada syntax highlighting, a movie extreme close-up focus that magnifies the pointed line while the rest falls out of depth of field, and an event-processing flash effect: every action is pushed onto an event bus (KEY / MOTION / EDIT / MODE / EX / SEARCH / SIGNAL / TICK / RUN / IO / ERROR) and the dispatched line lights up in that event's colour while a pulse of light sweeps across it, with an event-bus HUD and a throughput meter. Includes an Academy-leader movie countdown (a TICK event each second, full-screen flash at T-0) and a quantum Bada runtime (qubit / H / CNOT / measure). Self-contained HTML app, zero dependencies, fully offline.
author: Masaaki Yamaguchi
